criterion: 涵蓋大小溢位、來源有效長度不足、目的容量不足、靜態保證成立及保證失效重驗；未知情況不得視為安全。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Check multiplication before allocation, then verify valid source length and destination capacity. A static bound may discharge that exact check. Required finding for the counterexample: Checking only the wrapped result, or using a check after another writer changed the length, violates BND-CHECK-001.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
